_note: SpicyChat auth is Kinde OAuth2/OIDC (Authorization Code + PKCE S256). The 'oidc_configuration' block below is a REAL capture on 2026-07-06 from https://auth.spicychat.ai/.well-known/openid-configuration . Client config (from site JS bundle /v2/applications + VITE env): client_id=fb5754f42ee84f4787f9bd8ff49cac7a, domain=https://auth.spicychat.ai, org=org_7d8efc10ab9. 'guest_access' documents the anonymous path actually used for the PUBLIC catalog: the SPA generates/stores a guest user id (localStorage) and sends it as the X-Guest-UserId header; detail/list work with guest access and DO NOT require a Kinde login. The 'token_response_shape' and 'guest_user_response_shape' are REPRESENTATIVE placeholders (SYNTHETIC) - a real token exchange needs interactive browser login credentials which were not performed.

guest_access.description: Anonymous access used for public catalog. No Kinde login required.

required_headers.X-Guest-UserId: <uuid-v4 generated client-side and persisted in localStorage>

guest_access.optional_guest_bootstrap: POST https://prod.nd-api.com/v2/users  (site calls createResource('users') to register a guest; a client-generated UUID also works for read-only catalog/detail)

authenticated_request_shape.description: After login, API calls send Authorization: Bearer <access_token> alongside X-App-Id; X-Guest-UserId is dropped.
